title: Canederli al Formaggio: Italian Cheese Dumplings
ldName: Canederli al Formaggio: Italian Cheese Dumplings
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the bread into small pieces and transfer to a bowl with salt and pepper. Dice the cheese into small cubes. (We recommend edamer, tilsit, gorgonzola or grey cheese.)

Finely chop ½ onion and sauté in a pan with 1 teaspoon butter and 1 teaspoon oil. Mix ¼ liter milk with 4 eggs, the sautéed onion, bread, cheese and chopped parsley. Then mix in 3 tablespoons flour for consistency.
Shape the dumplings into small meatball shapes. Cook in boiling salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and dress with browned butter and grated parmesan cheese. Buon appetito!
